fields.name: Pharaoh
fields.description: Supreme leader of an Amenti community. Rare and powerful.

fields.name: High Priest/Priestess
fields.description: Religious leader and keeper of ancient rites.

fields.name: Vizier
fields.description: Chief administrator and advisor to higher-ranking Amenti.

fields.name: Keeper of Balance
fields.description: Guardian of Ma'at and cosmic order. Associated with the Web of Ma'at.

fields.name: Judge of Souls
fields.description: Weighs hearts and pronounces judgment. Associated with the Web of Osiris.

fields.name: Guardian
fields.description: Protector of sacred places and fellow Amenti. Associated with the Web of Horus.

fields.name: Preserver
fields.description: Keeper of knowledge and sacred objects. Associated with the Web of Isis.

fields.name: Lorekeeper
fields.description: Scholar and keeper of wisdom. Associated with the Web of Thoth.

fields.name: Elder
fields.description: Respected Amenti with many incarnations and much experience.

fields.name: Seeker
fields.description: Amenti on a quest for knowledge or redemption.

fields.name: Neophyte
fields.description: Newly awakened Amenti, still learning their purpose.
